answer: Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. Every claim climbs the oasis of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the river re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The ridge of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
